title: Playboy Magazine June 1976 Lillian Muller Playmate of the Year Sara Jane Moore
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible cover wear, spine wear or address label. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, June 1976 issue. Cover price $1.25.

Features:
- Playmate of the Year: Lillian Muller
- A chilling interview with Sara Jane Moore: "The Real Reason I Tried to Kill President Ford"
- The Whale War: High Noon at Sea with the Russians
- Was Richard Nixon a Wimp in High School? Was Ann-Margret? Raquel Welch? Playboy Tells All
- Sex Is Good For Your Body! Speeding Is Good for Your Soul!

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage.
